label: preparing
what: The innkeeper and local tradespeople are preparing a civic presentation of thanks for my public service, scheduled for Day 1 at 18:00 in the great hall. The baker is supplying forty-four loaves; the builder provided materials (oak planks and a lantern) as payment. The secretary knowingly handled the appointment and conveyed approval, but the evidence supports the innkeeper, baker, and builder as the preparation participants.
